page_title: PAR 0-0 GEN | Parma v Genoa 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
90+2' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals.
90+2' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) serves up a nice cross, but Edoardo Corvi punches the ball away.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joi Nuredini (Genoa) will replace Lorenzo Colombo.
89' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

88' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Edoardo Corvi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
87' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
82' Substitution. Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma) in, Gaetano Oristanio out.
81' Luca Pairetto has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lautaro Valenti (Parma).
80' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Milan Djuric (Parma), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
80' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
80' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Parma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' Stefano Sabelli doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Patrizio Masini (Genoa) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
76' Substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
76' Mateo Pellegrino comes off the pitch to be replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
75' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) replacing Vitinha.
73' Substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi makes his way off the pitch and Junior Messias (Genoa) comes on as his replacement.
73' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
72' What a chance that is! Mandela Keita (Parma) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
71' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
66' Vitinha (Genoa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
64' Genoa are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
61' The total number of attempts is 8:9.
57' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Vitinha (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
53' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

53' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.
52' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
49' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
47' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Carlos Cuesta makes a half-time substitution. Sascha Britschgi (Parma) comes on in place of Jacob Ondrejka.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+2' Vitinha (Genoa) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the left post but is denied by Edoardo Corvi, who pulls off a glorious save! Now Genoa have a corner.
45+1' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) is penalised for holding. Luca Pairetto signals a set piece.
43' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
41' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is first to the cross from Alessandro Marcandalli, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
40' It seemed like Aaron Martin (Genoa) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
39' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Enrico Del Prato (Parma) brought his opponent down.
38' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
36' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Circati (Parma) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
34' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
32' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender.
30' The corner from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is intercepted by the defence.

29' Nicola Leali pulls off a great save to deny Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
27' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Emanuele Valeri (Parma).
23' Genoa keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
20' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) for his blatant foul.
18' Vitinha (Genoa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Edoardo Corvi, who smothers the ball.

16' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Edoardo Corvi to get hold of the ball.
14' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is cleared to safety by the defence.
14' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Parma.
13' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
13' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
8' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

7' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Edoardo Corvi pulls off an easy save. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
5' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) is penalised for a foul. Luca Pairetto had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' A fine solo run by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Genoa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Luca Pairetto.
